title: Generate QR code for website

requirements.text: Generate a QR code image that encodes the Friends AC Services website URL

quotes: please generate a qr code for this website.

acceptanceCriteria: A QR code image is generated that links to the website URL
The QR code is scannable and properly encodes the website address
The image has appropriate dimensions for clear scanning (minimum 300x300px recommended)

requirements.text: Display the generated QR code in the Footer component alongside the existing contact information with appropriate styling and labeling

quotes: please generate a qr code for this website.

acceptanceCriteria: The QR code is visible in the Footer component
The QR code includes a descriptive label (e.g., 'Scan to visit our website')
The QR code styling is consistent with the existing warm accent color theme
The QR code is appropriately sized and positioned within the footer layout

requirements.text: Render the generated QR code image as a static asset in frontend/public/assets/generated directory for use in the Footer component
acceptanceCriteria: The QR code image file is saved in frontend/public/assets/generated
The image is referenced from the Footer component using the correct static asset path

constraints: The QR code must be generated as a static image asset, not dynamically rendered
Do not modify the backend for QR code generation
Maintain the existing Footer component layout and styling consistency
nonGoals: Dynamic QR code generation based on user input
Multiple QR codes for different pages
Custom QR code styling beyond standard format

required: QR code encoding the Friends AC Services website URL with high error correction and clear contrast (qr-code.dim_400x400.png)
